correctness.rationale: For the 24 orientation-preserving signed permutation matrices, independently formed all principal relative-rotation angles using the integer trace. The central distance-power matrix has the S4 character scalars (divided by pi^p) -3+8(2/3)^p-6(1/2)^p (dimension 1), 3-4(2/3)^p (multiplicity 4), 1-2(1/2)^p (multiplicity 9), and -3+2(1/2)^p (multiplicity 9). The 2D scalar changes sign exactly at p*=log(4/3)/log(3/2). Below that cutoff the other three are strictly negative: p*<1, b=(2/3)^p>=3/4, a=2^-p>1/2, b<sqrt(a) and 2sqrt(a)<=1+a. Above p* the positive 2D scalar obstructs conditional negative type. The centered Gram -HD_pH/2 therefore has rank 23 in the open admissible range and rank 19 at the endpoint. Schoenberg embedding and strict finite Gaussian positivity follow for distinct embedded points. For p>p*, the Gaussian is indefinite for small positive bandwidth by first-order expansion, yet tends to identity for large bandwidth. The independent 24x24 matrix computation at seven p-values matched all character spectra and ranks; numerical checks are corroborative only.
